anomalies.observed: On the AVR-ISP-6 header J5, pin 2 (MOSI) is wired to net NET0006, the same net as pin 4 (RST) and the ATtiny RESET/PB5 pin (U3.1 / U2.1).
anomalies.expected: MOSI must connect to the ATtiny's MOSI/DI pin PB0, which is net NET0008 (U3.5 / U2.5); only RST should be on NET0006.

evidence.quote: J5 AVR-ISP-6: MISO 1 NET0007, MOSI 2 NET0006, SCK 3 NET0002, RST 4 NET0006
U3 ATtiny45-20P: PB0 5 NET0008, PB1 6 NET0007, PB2 7 NET0002, RESET/PB5 1 NET0006

anomalies.impact: MOSI is shorted to the RESET line, so ISP programming will fail (MOSI data toggles RESET) and in normal operation PB0/SDA is tied to the reset pin.

anomalies.observed: C1, the only capacitor on the LM1117-5.0 output rail (+5V), is 100 nF.
anomalies.expected: The LM1117 requires a minimum output capacitance of about 10 uF for stability; 100 nF is far too small.

evidence.quote: U1 LM1117-5.0: VO 2 -> +5V; C1 100nF from +5V to GND

anomalies.impact: The 5V rail may be unstable/oscillate, especially at light load.

parsed.summary: The AVR-ISP header J5 appears to have its MOSI pin tied to the RESET net NET0006 instead of PB0 (NET0008), shorting MOSI to RESET; the LM1117 output capacitor is also far below the recommended value.
